title: LAVIFT: Latent-Action-Guided Vision Fine-Tuning for Surgical Interaction Recognition
summary: Understanding instrument-tissue interactions is essential for context-aware surgical AI and autonomous robotic surgery. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) and vision encoders offer an alternative to conventional interaction classifiers by transferring broad visual and semantic knowledge. However, adapting them to fine-grained surgical interactions remains challenging: (1) freezing the vision encoder depends entirely on pretrained representations that may retain noise and provide weak spatial localization, while (2) full fine-tuning can improve global semantic alignment without ensuring that the encoder learns meaningful features in the correct action region. We address these limitations by introducing LAViFiT, an end-to-end latent-action-guided framework for vision-language fine-tuning. An inverse dynamics model captures the visual changes induced by each action, while a forward world model drives the encoder to represent action-relevant regions. A patch-level SIG Regularizer further prevents local feature collapse without additional supervision, such as bounding boxes or pseudo-labels. Experiments across multiple encoders and datasets improve recognition and image-text alignment, while representation analyses show stronger grounding over the complete instrument-tissue interaction region and more spatially coherent features.
tldr: LAViFiT introduces a latent-action-guided fine-tuning framework for vision-language models that improves instrument-tissue interaction recognition in surgical robotics by using an inverse dynamics model and a forward world model to focus on action-relevant regions, along with a patch-level regularizer to prevent feature collapse.
tldr_zh: LAViFiT提出了一种潜在动作引导的视觉-语言模型微调框架，通过逆动力学模型和前向世界模型聚焦作用相关区域，并结合补丁级正则化防止特征坍塌，从而提升手术机器人中器械-组织交互识别的性能。
summary_zh: 理解器械-组织交互对于情境感知的手术人工智能和自主机器人手术至关重要。预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）和视觉编码器通过迁移广泛的视觉和语义知识，为传统交互分类器提供了替代方案。然而，将它们适配到细粒度的手术交互仍具挑战性：（1）冻结视觉编码器完全依赖于预训练表示，这些表示可能保留噪声且空间定位能力较弱；（2）完全微调可以改善全局语义对齐，但无法确保编码器在正确的动作区域学习有意义的特征。为解决这些局限，我们提出了LAViFiT——一种端到端的潜在动作引导的视觉-语言微调框架。逆动力学模型捕捉每个动作引起的视觉变化，而前向世界模型驱动编码器表征与动作相关的区域。补丁级别的SIG正则化器无需额外监督（如边界框或伪标签）即可防止局部特征坍缩。在多个编码器和数据集上的实验表明，该框架提升了识别和图像-文本对齐性能，而表征分析显示其在完整器械-组织交互区域上具有更强的定位能力以及更空间连贯的特征。

title: Distributed Acoustic Localization Array Deployed Using a Soft Everting Vine Robot
summary: Soft robot exteroception is increasingly being explored for a variety of field applications. In this work, we present a sound-based system for localizing disaster victims in confined and unstructured environments, based on a distributed acoustic sensing architecture embedded along the body of a soft everting vine robot. We propose a dynamic Steered Response Power with Phase Transform framework that supports both far-field direction-of-arrival estimation and near-field three-dimensional source localization as the robot approaches the sound source. To better understand the design and control space related to localizing sound using a soft, shape-morphing robot body, we conduct experiments measuring the accuracy of these methods for a five-microphone array attached to the robot body using three placements relative to the outer membrane of the robot (inside the pressurized body, inside the inner tail, and outside the outer wall) and in four robot configurations (linear, double linear, circular, and sinusoidal). We measure the change in accuracy as the signal-to-noise ratio, the direction of approach, and the distance of the sound source from the center of the array change. Finally, we demonstrate a vine robot growing into an arbitrary shape while carrying microphones along its outer wall, and show that a sound source located with the array's near field can be localized with high accuracy after only three microphones have everted from the robot body. These results highlight the potential of distributed acoustic sensing for reliable victim localization using soft growing robots.
tldr: This paper presents a distributed acoustic localization system using a soft everting vine robot with an embedded microphone array, employing a dynamic SRP-PHAT framework for both far-field and near-field sound source localization. Experiments demonstrate high accuracy even with partial deployment, highlighting potential for victim localization in confined spaces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于软体外翻藤蔓机器人的分布式声学定位系统，通过嵌入的麦克风阵列和动态SRP-PHAT框架实现远场和近场声源定位。实验表明即使部分部署也能达到高精度，展示了在受限空间中进行受害者定位的潜力。
summary_zh: 软体机器人的外部感知技术正越来越多地被探索应用于各种现场场景。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于声音的系统，用于在受限且非结构化的环境中定位灾难受害者，该系统基于沿软体外翻式藤蔓机器人身体嵌入的分布式声学传感架构。我们提出了一种动态相位变换引导响应功率框架，该框架支持远场到达方向估计以及机器人接近声源时的近场三维源定位。为更好地理解利用软体、形状可变的机器人身体进行声音定位的设计与控制空间，我们通过实验测量了这些方法在五麦克风阵列上的精度，该阵列以三种相对于机器人外膜的位置（加压机体内部、内尾部内部、外壁外侧）安装于机器人身体，并在四种机器人构型（直线型、双直线型、圆弧型、正弦型）下进行测试。我们测量了当信噪比、接近方向以及声源到阵列中心的距离变化时精度的变化。最后，我们展示了一台藤蔓机器人沿其外壁携带麦克风生长成任意形状，并证明当阵列近场中的声源只有三个麦克风从机器人身体中外翻时，即可实现高精度定位。这些结果凸显了分布式声学传感在利用软体生长机器人实现可靠受害者定位方面的潜力。

title: Bayesian uncertainty estimation improves clinical decision making in medical AI agents
summary: Machine learning models for medical image analysis typically lack a reliable measure of confidence, limiting their use in ambiguous or atypical cases. Here we show that Monte Carlo dropout, applied to a multi-task chest-radiograph classifier (eight thoracic findings, 137,593 training images), provides an epistemic uncertainty signal that tracks generalisation across training-set scales and flags confident yet error-prone predictions. Adding this signal to the point prediction raised error-detection AUROC from 0.74 to 0.77 ($Δ$AUROC +0.023, 95% CI [+0.014, +0.033]). In a controlled 2x2 factorial experiment, a clinical-decision-support agent exploited this uncertainty only when it was delivered as a binary error-risk flag rather than as raw scores, cutting confident misdiagnoses on unreliable findings from 8.5% to 2.7%. Epistemic uncertainty estimation thus carries decision-relevant information beyond point predictions, but its value for downstream agents depends on how it is communicated.
tldr: This paper shows that adding epistemic uncertainty estimates (via Monte Carlo dropout) to a chest X-ray classifier improves error detection, and that communicating this uncertainty as a binary error-risk flag (rather than raw scores) significantly reduces confident misdiagnoses in a clinical decision-support agent.
tldr_zh: 该论文表明，通过蒙特卡洛丢弃法为胸部X光分类器添加认知不确定性估计可提升错误检测能力，并且以二值化错误风险标志（而非原始分数）传递该不确定性，能显著减少临床决策支持代理中的自信误诊。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
用于医学图像分析的机器学习模型通常缺乏可靠的置信度度量，这限制了其在模棱两可或非典型病例中的应用。本文证明，将蒙特卡洛丢弃法应用于多任务胸部X光片分类器（涉及八种胸部病变，训练图像共137,593张），能够提供一种认知不确定性信号，该信号可追踪模型在训练集规模变化时的泛化能力，并标记出高置信度但易出错的预测。将此信号加入点预测后，错误检测的AUROC从0.74提升至0.77（ΔAUROC +0.023，95% CI [+0.014, +0.033]）。在一项受控的2×2析因实验中，临床决策支持工具仅在该不确定性以二值错误风险标记（而非原始分数）形式呈现时加以利用，使不可靠病变上的自信误诊率从8.5%降至2.7%。因此，认知不确定性估计蕴含超越点预测的决策相关信息，但其对下游智能体的价值取决于信息的传达方式。

title: Clinical Pathways as Safety Specifications for Physical AI in Hospital Wards
summary: Ensuring safety in Physical AI systems operating in real-world environments is a critical challenge, particularly in hospital wards where vulnerable patients, clinical staff, medical devices, and assistive robots coexist. In this paper, we reinterpret Clinical Pathways as explicit runtime safety specifications for embodied medical AI. We propose a conceptual robotic architecture that integrates wearable sensors, smart medical devices, and assistive robotic components into a unified framework for real-time safety monitoring. At its core, a Runtime Safety Monitor (RSM) evaluates multimodal physiological and system-level signals against clinically defined constraints derived from the prescribed care process. Rather than relying solely on statistical anomaly detection, the proposed approach combines temporal prediction, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and constraint-based verification to identify safety violations. The RSM targets three classes of events: physiological deviations from prescribed care, hardware and communication failures, and potential data tampering or misuse. This work contributes to Safe Physical AI by operationalizing domain-specific clinical knowledge as enforceable safety constraints, bridging learning-based perception and runtime safety monitoring to assist nursing staff in real-world hospital wards.
tldr: This paper proposes using clinical pathways as explicit safety specifications for physical AI in hospital wards, and introduces a runtime safety monitor that combines temporal prediction, uncertainty reasoning, and constraint-based verification to detect physiological deviations, hardware failures, and data tampering.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将临床路径作为医院病房中物理AI的显式安全规范，并引入一种运行时安全监控器，结合时间预测、不确定性推理和基于约束的验证来检测生理偏差、硬件故障和数据篡改。
summary_zh: 确保在真实环境中运行的物理AI系统的安全性是一项关键挑战，尤其是在脆弱患者、临床工作人员、医疗设备和辅助机器人共存的医院病房中。本文将临床路径重新诠释为具身医疗AI的显式运行时安全规范。我们提出了一种概念性的机器人架构，将可穿戴传感器、智能医疗设备和辅助机器人组件集成到一个统一的框架中，用于实时安全监控。其核心是一个运行时安全监视器（RSM），它根据从预定护理过程中导出的临床定义约束，评估多模态生理和系统级信号。该方法并非仅依赖统计异常检测，而是结合时间预测、不确定性感知推理和基于约束的验证来识别安全违规。RSM针对三类事件：与预定护理的生理偏差、硬件与通信故障，以及潜在的数据篡改或滥用。本工作通过将特定领域的临床知识转化为可强制执行的安全约束，桥接基于学习的感知与运行时安全监控，从而协助真实医院病房中的护理人员，为安全物理AI做出贡献。

title: MedDiT4SR: Tri-Stream Joint Adaptation of Pre-Trained Diffusion Transformers for Medical Image Super-Resolution
summary: Medical image super-resolution (MedSR) requires recovering fine anatomical structures from degraded observations while avoiding unsupported details introduced by generative priors. Large-scale pre-trained multimodal diffusion transformers provide strong visual priors, but their adaptation to MedSR remains non-trivial. In conventional ControlNet-style adaptation, the low-resolution (LR) image is processed as an external condition and injected into the denoising stream through one-way connections. Consequently, LR anatomical evidence cannot be jointly updated with the evolving denoising and semantic representations. We propose MedDiT4SR, a tri-stream adaptation framework that integrates the LR, noisy latent, and text representations into the same multimodal diffusion-transformer blocks. To complement global token interaction, we introduce a Super-Resolution Adapter (SR Adapter) that aggregates scale-dependent local tokens and suppresses interpolation-induced redundancy. We further propose a Semantic Alignment Refiner (SA Refiner) that calibrates local LR responses using prompt-conditioned semantic information. Experiments under both in-domain and within-modality cross-dataset settings demonstrate the effectiveness of adapting large-scale pre-trained DiT models to medical image super-resolution across diverse imaging domains.
tldr: This paper proposes MedDiT4SR, a tri-stream adaptation framework that integrates low-resolution, noisy latent, and text representations into pre-trained multimodal diffusion transformers for medical image super-resolution, outperforming conventional ControlNet-style methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MedDiT4SR，一种三流适应框架，将低分辨率、噪声潜变量和文本表示集成到预训练的多模态扩散变换器中，用于医学图像超分辨率，性能优于传统的ControlNet风格方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学图像超分辨率（MedSR）需要从退化观测中恢复精细的解剖结构，同时避免由生成先验引入的无依据细节。大规模预训练的多模态扩散变换器提供了强大的视觉先验，但其在MedSR中的适配仍具挑战性。在传统的ControlNet风格适配中，低分辨率（LR）图像被作为外部条件处理，并通过单向连接注入去噪流中。因此，LR解剖证据无法与不断演化的去噪表示和语义表示联合更新。我们提出MedDiT4SR，一种三流适配框架，将LR、噪声潜变量和文本表示集成到相同的多模态扩散变换器模块中。为了补充全局令牌交互，我们引入了一个超分辨率适配器（SR Adapter），用于聚合尺度相关的局部令牌并抑制插值引起的冗余。我们还提出了一个语义对齐精炼器（SA Refiner），利用提示条件语义信息校准局部LR响应。在域内和模态内跨数据集设置下的实验表明，将大规模预训练的DiT模型适配到跨多种成像领域的医学图像超分辨率中是有效的。

title: Pathologist Attention-Aligned Report Generation for Prostate Histopathology
summary: The allocation of visual attention by pathologists during cancer diagnosis is a highly selective process that critically shapes the information extracted from whole-slide images (WSIs). Human attention helps medical imaging tasks such as classification and segmentation, and becomes a strong semantic cue for identifying diagnostically informative regions for report generation. In this paper, we introduce human attention into the training of pathologist report generation models. To this end, we collected a multimodal human-attention dataset of 121 prostate WSIs annotated with pathologists' multi-scale viewport trajectories synchronized with the pathologists' verbal descriptions and cursor movements for five clinically relevant components (e.g., Gleason patterns). Using this dataset, we finetune two report generation models with an attention-alignment loss that regularizes the model attention over image patches to match the distribution of pathologist attention. We evaluate our approach on prostate cancer report generation and visual question answering using two models with different internal attention mechanisms (i.e., how image tokens are integrated into the language decoder). Experiments show average gains of 10.9% on NLP-based metrics and 19.3% in accuracy across five clinically relevant report components. Further, model attention maps extracted at inference time, with minimal computational overhead, align more closely with pathologist attention, providing stronger visual support for the generated reports by highlighting the regions that most influence the output.
tldr: This paper introduces pathologist visual attention to guide prostate cancer report generation by finetuning models with an attention-alignment loss, achieving improvements in NLP metrics and attention map alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文通过引入病理学家的视觉注意力来指导前列腺癌报告生成，使用注意力对齐损失微调模型，在NLP指标和注意力图对齐方面取得改进。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
病理学家在癌症诊断过程中的视觉注意力分配是一个高度选择性的过程，它从根本上决定了从全切片图像（WSI）中提取的信息。人类注意力有助于医学成像任务（如分类和分割），并成为识别诊断信息丰富区域以生成报告的重要语义线索。本文首次将人类注意力引入病理学家报告生成模型的训练中。为此，我们构建了一个多模态人类注意力数据集，包含121张前列腺WSI，标注了病理学家在五个临床相关组件（如Gleason分级模式）上的多尺度视口轨迹，并与病理学家的口头描述和光标移动同步。利用该数据集，我们通过注意力对齐损失对两个报告生成模型进行微调，该损失函数对模型在图像块上的注意力进行正则化，使其匹配病理学家注意力的分布。我们针对前列腺癌报告生成和视觉问答任务，使用两种具有不同内部注意力机制（即图像令牌如何整合到语言解码器中）的模型评估了我们的方法。实验表明，在五个临床相关报告组件上，基于NLP的指标平均提升10.9%，准确率提升19.3%。此外，在推理阶段提取的模型注意力图（计算开销极小）与病理学家的注意力更为一致，通过突出影响输出的关键区域，为生成的报告提供了更强的视觉支持。
